name: talkative: small talk before every answer, one cut-off line at the second security question; identity passes with each value sent once, no sympathy for the small talk, no close before the account is read
note: Run with a practice customer: --case <id> --practice (generated cases: --cases <file>). {{answer1}}/{{answer2}} are the case's security answers in the order of its identity block (--answers '[...]' overrides). Brief-agnostic: no bank value, product or wording; only the security-question vocabulary may need the brief's own words.
turns: Oh hello, sorry, what a morning, the bus was late and it is pouring with rain here. Yes, this is me speaking.
Ah right, I have just put the kettle on, my sister is staying with us this week so the house is chaos. It's {{answer1}}.
Hang on, the neighbour's dog is barking again, it does that every single time the post comes, so it's
Sorry about that, where was I. {{answer2}}.

expect.note: small talk plus 'yes, this is me' is a confirmation: a security question follows, no bank tool yet
the answer after the small talk is sent once, with the right value
a sentence cut off before the answer is not an answer and not a refusal: no call with a half value, no close
the agent asks again or asks the customer to go on, instead of moving on
identity passed: the account is read and the call goes on; nothing is closed or recorded on small talk
no sympathy sentence for small talk (a brief's single sympathy sentence is for hardship, not for rain or a busy morning)
